findings.passage: The General Assembly needs to repeal our permitless carry law, which removes every guardrail around carrying a loaded weapon in public.
findings.note: Op-ed by Karen Lupton ('Our kids should not have to triage their own generation'). Calls for repeal of the permitless carry law. Text obtained through the fetch tool's exact-sentence request, which returned the sentence in segments.
subjects: carry a gun without a permit

findings.passage: we should require a background check with every gun purchase — no loopholes.
findings.note: Same op-ed. Calls for a background check on every gun purchase; the preceding clause says felons can buy guns easily online or at gun shows where no check is needed. Passage is the last part of that sentence as returned by the fetch tool.
subjects: check every gun buyer

findings.passage: Safe gun storage can become the norm.
findings.note: Same op-ed. Backs safe storage of guns so children are less likely to find a loaded weapon.
subjects: safe storage of guns
